data_dictionary.none_state: NONE means the strategic base is destroyed or demolished and has not been rebuilt by either faction; it is effectively no-man's-land.
data_dictionary.rate_trends: Adjacent equal-window comparison. Array order is [recent_per_hour, previous_per_hour, change_per_hour, direction].
data_dictionary.recent_events: A direct ownership flip can produce a loss row plus a capture row for the same state transition.
data_dictionary.selected_metrics: Evidence citation keys whose values and observation times are frozen at prediction time.
data_dictionary.total_enlistments: Cumulative unique players who have deployed to this region during the war. A player can count in multiple regions. This is not current population or a faction split; its change is only a new-to-that-region activity proxy.

previous_model_summary.headline: Island Fronts Erupt As Stlican Shelf Flips To Warden Lead
previous_model_summary.war_summary: Island sectors have erupted into sudden motion over the past three hours, led by Fisherman's Row where nine rapid base transactions swept through Arcadia, Eidolo, and Black Well, though Colonial garrisons retain hold of all nine positions. Across the sea at Tempest Island, Reef saw four swift exchanges in the last two hours, leaving the island completely under Colonial control. On the eastern mainland, Stlican Shelf underwent a dramatic reversal: four base actions in two hours propelled Warden forces into a five-to-three lead over the Colonials, with one contested position demolished in no-man's-land. Weathered Expanse remains locked in bitter combat, logging six fresh base changes in two hours around Frostmarch and Crow's Nest while swallowing more than 2,100 casualties in an unbroken four-to-five stalemate. Severe attrition persists without territorial shifts in Callahan's Passage and Mooring County, where combined casualties topped 2,000 and 1,300 respectively over the last two hours. Meanwhile, earlier turmoil in Linn of Mercy and Marban Hollow has largely subsided into steady trench warfare without further positional collapse.
